keyEvents.text: Goal! Paris FC 1, Monaco 0. Lassine Sinayoko (Paris FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Maxime Lopez.
Goal! Paris FC 2, Monaco 0. Lassine Sinayoko (Paris FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Moses Simon with a through ball.
First Half ends, Paris FC 2, Monaco 0.
Substitution, Paris FC. Moustapha Mbow replaces Samir Chergui.
Substitution, Monaco. Christian Mawissa replaces Edan Diop.
Substitution, Monaco. Folarin Balogun replaces Paris Brunner.
Substitution, Monaco. Takumi Minamino replaces Denis Zakaria.
Substitution, Monaco. Mathys Detourbet replaces Flávio Nazinho.
Goal! Paris FC 2, Monaco 1. Folarin Balogun (Monaco) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Vanderson with a cross.
Vanderson (Monaco) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Paris FC. Rudy Matondo replaces Moses Simon.
Substitution, Paris FC. Patrick Zabi replaces Ilan Kebbal.
Goal! Paris FC 3, Monaco 1. Pablo Pagis (Paris FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lassine Sinayoko.
Substitution, Monaco. Jordan Teze replaces Sadibou Sané.
Substitution, Paris FC. Omar Sissoko replaces Lassine Sinayoko.
Hamari Traoré (Paris FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Lamine Camara (Monaco) is shown the yellow card.
Pablo Pagis (Paris FC) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Paris FC. Emmanuel Mbemba replaces Hamari Traoré.
Second Half ends, Paris FC 3, Monaco 1.
